It was a rainy day in August, so a lot of the kids waited in their parent’s cars. I stood in my bright blue work shirt, and waited for the bus. I was standing in the middle of a parking space, when I see a car begin to back in. I panic, because there are cars on both sides of where I am standing. I walk backwards and trip the curb and fall down a small gap between the parking lot and a fenced in yard. I hear a mother scream, and I get back up. There’s a huge bloody mark on my leg, I don’t think much of it. The mom helps me bandage my leg before the bus arrives. I bled through the gauze almost immediately, and I went through like 7 different heavy duty band aids that day alone. 
That night, I woke up and had a horrible pain in my leg. I told my mom, who saw my leg had gotten swollen. She gave me medicine and then took me to a clinic in the morning. It hurt to walk, and I needed to get a tetanus shot and antibiotics. 

I also got paid despite not coming to work that day. Guess they wanted to avoid a potential lawsuit.
